title: Sup-norm bound for integrals of test functions against a Radon outer measure
statement: Let X be a topological space (universe u) and μ a Radon outer measure on X (Simon Def. 4.6, Lean IsRadonOuterMeasure μ). Let μ̄ := caratheodoryMeasure μ (μ restricted to the μ-measurable sets). Let f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ) and C ∈ ℝ with |f(x)| ≤ C for all x ∈ X. Then |∫_X f dμ̄| ≤ μ(tsupport f)·C. Here μ(tsupport f), which is finite by (R1), is read as a real number (Lean ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (μ : OuterMeasure X), IsRadonOuterMeasure μ → ∀ (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) (C : ℝ), (∀ x, |f x| ≤ C) → |∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure μ| ≤ (μ (tsupport f)).toReal * C
